Please fill out at least some of the following fields, the more you can find the faster I can get it synced. Examples given are for the song *Answers*

1. What are the song details (i.e. name, bgm id(s), locations played?) Provide as many as possible
  - Song Name: Answers
  - Song Ids (viewable via the [Orchestrion plugin](https://github.com/perchbirdd/OrchestrionPlugin)): 
132, 237, 238, 240, 898
  - Location: Final Coils of Bahamut

2. Are any lyrics known? Please link the source(s), and the type (official/unofficial/some official, some unoffical).
  - Official, [link to forums](https://forum.square-enix.com/ffxiv/threads/58479-Answers-Answered%21)

3. If not in English, are there any translations? Please link the source(s), and the type (official/unofficial/some official, some unofficial)
  - N/A

4. Are the credits for the song known? Please provide the known credits and the source. If provided lyrics were community created/unofficial, please include the handle(s) of the authors who posted them.
  - Composer: Nobuo Uematsu
  - Arranger: Tsutomu Narita
  - Lyrics: Yaeko Sato & Koji Fox
  - Singer: Susan Calloway
  - Source: [Wiki](https://finalfantasy.fandom.com/wiki/Answers_(Final_Fantasy_XIV))

5. If you provided more than just a song name (i.e. tracked down / theorycrafted unknown lyrics, found all bgm ids/locations played, etc.), do you wish to be credited in the `[by: ...]` tag in the file? If so, please provide a tag to be added.
  - RajahOmen

6. Any comments about the lyrics/sync to be added as a `[#: ...]` tag? Usually used for explaining why some sections may be missing, other misc quirks of the sync, how unofficial lyrics were derived, etc.
  - N/A
